label: VERIFIED
extraction: Awesome LLM Agent Orchestration curated 2026 papers. Key papers: 1) Learning to Orchestrate Agents in Natural Language with the Conductor (ICLR 2026) - RL-trained natural-language conductor for topology and prompt orchestration. 2) MAS-Orchestra (ICML 2026) - holistic multi-agent orchestration as function-calling RL. 3) ProgRouter (EMNLP 2026 Findings). 4) ACE-Router (ACL 2026) - history-aware routing from MCP tools to open Agent Web. 5) EvoRoute (ACL 2026) - experience-driven self-routing for cost-latency-quality tradeoffs. 6) Learning What to Retain (EMNLP 2026) - gated-memory routing for efficient collaboration. 7) Budget-Aware Tool Use Enables Effective Agent Scaling (COLM 2026). 8) MCP-Bench (ICLR 2026) - MCP-server benchmark for tool-using agents. 9) SwarmBench (EMNLP 2026 Findings) - evaluation suite for dynamically orchestrated agent swarms. 10) The Orchestration of Multi-Agent Systems: Architectures, Protocols, and Communication (arXiv 2026) - survey. These papers cover routing, orchestration, memory, budget-aware scaling, and benchmarking for multi-agent systems.
